Takeaways by Bloomberg AI

Thoma Bravo-backed Proofpoint Inc. has kicked off a near $2 billion debt sale to finance an acquisition and extend the maturity of a term loan, according to people familiar with the matter.

The company on Monday unveiled a $1.25 billion five-year bondBloomberg Terminal to support its acquisition of fellow cybersecurity company Varonis Systems Inc., while a $735 million leveraged loan will complete an effort by Proofpoint to amend and extend its term loan debt to 2030 from 2028, said the people, who requested anonymity because the transactions are private.
